hypothesis: The area-balance tolerance of the partitioner (area_balance_error=0.1) is quite tight, forcing the partitioner to move non-critical macros to satisfy balance; loosening it to 0.15 lets the cut objective keep timing-relevant macros on their preferred tier, reducing cross-tier detours and TNS.
analysis: Hypothesis not supported: total score −0.077, all cases valid, but only bp-ng45 improved (+0.027, dTNS +7.2%). ariane133-ng45 was slightly negative (−0.009) despite dWNS +5.0% and dTNS −4.4%, and bp_fe-ng45 regressed sharply (−0.095, dWNS −14.1%), suggesting looser balance let timing-critical macros drift to worse tiers there. Mechanism is case-dependent, not general. Next step: sweep area_balance_error (0.10–0.15) per design, or apply 0.15 only where tier capacity is asymmetric, and re-check bp_fe-ng45 macro-tier assignments.
